environment.description: EC2 c5.large running Amazon Linux 2023 with kernel 6.1, application deployed via ECS task definition with custom seccomp profile (based on default Docker profile with additional restrictions). Task definition specifies linuxParameters.capabilities.drop including CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. The container runtime enforces a bespoke seccomp filter that denies mprotect(PROT_EXEC), mmap with PROT_EXEC|PROT_WRITE, execve for non-allowlisted binaries, and process_vm_writev. Host has kernel.randomize_va_space=2 and the binary is compiled with -fstack-protector-strong -pie -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now. Note: the dropped capabilities alone do not prevent buffer overflow exploitation; the combination with the seccomp mprotect/mmap restriction and full ASLR+PIE+RELRO is what blocks shellcode execution and ROP-to-exec chains.
